title: NULL in unfinished backups
description: Fix the query so it returns backups whose finished_seq is NULL. Return exactly two columns: backup_id, database_name. Sort by backup_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT backup_id, database_name
FROM backups
WHERE finished_seq = NULL
ORDER BY backup_id ASC;
hints: NULL cannot be tested correctly with =.
solution_explanation: = NULL evaluates to UNKNOWN; IS NULL selects unfinished rows.
